steps.content:
Based on those two listings, you should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio**: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/4jh74g/a

They are selling the **exact same product for the exact same price**, so the return policy is the tie-breaker:

| | **A - Ottervale Audio** | **B - Brackmoor Sound** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days - In stock | Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days - In stock |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Returns** | **Free 90-day returns** | **30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping** |

**Why A is better:**

1.  **3x longer to decide:** 90 days vs 30 days gives you much more time to test comfort, fit, and noise-cancelling in real use.
2.  **Risk-free:** If you don't like them or have a problem, you can return for free to Ottervale. With Brackmoor you would have to pay return shipping out of your own pocket.

Since price, shipping, warranty, and product specs are identical, Ottervale Audio gives you the same headphones with zero extra cost and much better buyer protection. If you are sure you won't need to return them, either seller is fine - but there's no downside to choosing A.
